Subject: Blended-rate pilot + renewal scaling — proposal & next steps

Hi Sara,

Thanks again for the call earlier — great to hear Hearthwell's usage patterns for the patient-summarization pipeline. Per our discussion, I've attached a short proposal that blends a short-term promotional rate with a path to co-term and scale as you migrate additional workloads. The two key options inside the PDF are: an initial 90-day blended-rate pilot (convertible to committed capacity) and an accelerated top-up that co-terms to your existing June 30 renewal.

Highlights in the attached Redwood_BlendedPilot_Proposal.pdf: 
- 90-day blended pilot: 15% discount on hosted API tokens for first quarter + 30% convertible credit on any committed uplift converted to Dedicated within 60 days.
- Co-term option: pro-rated top-up to align to June 30, with monthly true-up and a safety-fallback to a lower-cost quantized model if burst capacity is reached.
- SLA carve-outs: 99.9% baseline with crediting approach for major incidents; legal-friendly language in SOW_Hearthwell_v2.docx.

Ask: can you confirm procurement's target for legal review and PO issuance? If it helps, Ben can share an itemized invoice schedule and Irena/Irene (ops/legal) can slot a short call with your contracts team next week.

Proposed next step: 30-min sync Thurs 12/14 at 10:00 AM PT to lock in payment terms and timeline.

Thanks —
David Kim
Sr. Account Executive, Redwood Inference
(direct) +1 415-555-0198

Hi David,

Appreciate the write-up and the attachments — skimmed through this morning. A few quick clarifying questions before we commit time: 
1) For the 90-day blended pilot, is the 15% discount applied to both generation tokens and embeddings or generation only? We run a non-trivial embedding workload for search vectors.
2) How will the 30% convertible credit be documented — is that a credit on invoice or a separate voucher we apply when we convert to Dedicated?
3) Procurement timeline: legal needs at least 7 business days for any SOW with new SLA language, and finance needs PO + net30 for first invoice. Can Redwood accept net30?
4) If we co-term to June 30, can you provide a sample pro-rata math example in the invoice schedule? Our finance team likes to see explicit proration rows.

Also looping in procurement@hearthwell.com for visibility — they prefer a DocuSign for signatures. If you have a draft DocuSign link that avoids too many manual redlines, that helps speed things up.

Thanks,
Sara Lloyd
Senior Procurement Manager | Hearthwell

Sara — thanks for the quick read and great questions. I wanted to respond inline and offer the practical pricing math so procurement has concrete numbers for the PO.

1) Discount scope: the 15% pilot discount applies to usage-based token generation and embeddings in the hosted API for the 90-day period. We'll call out token categories on the invoice so it's explicit.

2) Convertible credit mechanics: we issue a transferable invoice credit (voucher) for 30% of pilot spend that appears as a line-item credit on your account. When you convert to Dedicated, that credit can be applied against the committed capacity invoice within the 60-day conversion window. We'll note this in the SOW; legal can accept voucher -> credit language.

3) Payment terms: Net30 is acceptable for first invoice. For co-term top-ups we can do net30 as well; if you require extended payment terms we can request exec approval but let's start with net30 to keep the timeline tight.

4) Proration example (co-term to 6/30):
- Current renewal: $120k annual (Jan–Dec)
- Proposed immediate top-up: $30k committed for 6 months (Jan–Jun) -> pro-rated to $15k for Jan–Jun when aligned to 6/30 co-term (invoice will show gross then prorated credit)
- Pilot spend estimated at $12k -> 30% convertible credit = $3.6k applied if you convert to Dedicated within 60 days.

Offer: If Hearthwell signs DocuSign for the SOW and PO is issued by 12/22, Redwood will: 
- Lock the 15% pilot discount for the first 90 days
- Guarantee the 30% convertible credit as described
- Provide a line-item example schedule exported from our billing system for your finance team (I can send CSV sample).

Next steps: David/Irene — can you prep the DocuSign with the SOW redlines and send to Sara + procurement? Sara — if Thurs 12/14 10:00 AM PT still works, we can finalize wording and I can push the draft invoice schedule.

Cheers,
Ben Carter
